# PHASE 5 — Accessibility Report

## Search Component
- `aria-label` on search input: was hardcoded → now uses `langService.t('search.input_aria')` ✅
- `aria-label` on search button: was hardcoded → now uses `langService.t('search.btn_searching')` / `langService.t('search.btn_search')` ✅
- Focus states: unchanged ✅
- Keyboard navigation: `onKeydown(Enter)` logic untouched ✅

## Reports List Component
- `aria-label` on download PDF button: was hardcoded "Download PDF" → now `langService.t('reports.card.download_pdf_aria')` ✅
- `aria-label` on download Word button: was hardcoded "Download Word document" → now `langService.t('reports.card.download_word_aria')` ✅
- `aria-label` on delete button: was hardcoded "Delete report" → now `langService.t('reports.card.delete_aria')` ✅
- `aria-label` on modal close button: was hardcoded "Close dialog" → now `langService.t('reports.modal.close_aria')` ✅
- Modal `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"` and `aria-labelledby`: preserved ✅
- `aria-labelledby="generate-report-title"` — heading id preserved ✅

## Report Viewer Component
- No aria attributes present in original (none needed) ✅

## Notifications Component
- Already fully accessible from Phase 2 ✅

## Summary
All ARIA labels that were hardcoded English strings have been localized. Modal accessibility attributes (role, aria-modal, aria-labelledby) preserved unchanged. Keyboard navigation untouched.
